purpose: Every Latin Modern Roman OpenType face render-pipeline fonts.rs (FontSet::latin_modern_file, t1lmr.fd boundaries) can request at 9aaec57a, beyond the three Commander-pinned files (lmroman10-regular, lmroman12-regular, latinmodern-math), so a Mac without MacTeX never substitutes a text face and flashtex-pdf-exact from-v2 never refuses an export naming a missing font (pdf-2 finding: HW1 needs LMRoman8-Regular).

entries.role: secondary math face: flashtex-render (crates/render-pipeline mathfont::BB_FONT) draws every double-struck code point (\mathbb, U+2102/210D/2115/2119/211A/211D/2124, U+1D538-1D56B) from this face because its design and advances follow AMS msbm10, which pdfLaTeX uses for \mathbb; Latin Modern Math's double-struck block is the sans-like open face
